name: Hero Dungeon
detailed_description:
Pick your path. Shape your power. Slay what's next.

Descend into ever-shifting dungeons where every battle transforms you. Hero Dungeon is a 2D roguelite auto-battler where you draft powerful cards to change how your hero fights — and how you survive.

Each run throws new enemies, modifiers, and wild card synergies your way. Will you create a lightning-fast combo engine? A slow, unstoppable juggernaut? Or something completely unexpected?

⚔ Features:

  • Strategic Card Drafting – After each fight, pick an upgrade card that reshapes your hero’s attacks, defenses, and combat behavior.

  • Auto-Battling Action – Your hero fights automatically — your strategy and card choices determine their strength, style, and survival.

  • Endless Replayability – Procedurally generated dungeons, evolving enemy encounters, and countless card synergies keep every run fresh.

  • Wild Build Potential – Stack cards to create insane combos, unexpected behaviors, and game-breaking strategies.

Master the dungeon, one card at a time — your choices, your survival.
